question:
Select the set of numbers from the given options which is **NOT simila**r to the given set.

(12, 81, 15)
solution:
The pattern followed here is :

**(1st number + 3rd number) × 3 = 2nd number**

 
• **(12, 81,15) → (12 + 15) × 3 = 27 × 3 = 81**

Similarly,

 
• (11, 69, 12) &rarr
